correctness.rationale: All graph edges and disjoint-pair two-cells are enumerated by five types. The signed integral cubical boundary gives exactly A=C=0, R=-P, T=P, P symmetric and zero-row-sum; since there are no three-cells the full top homology is precisely ker B_t, not a finite-index subgroup. The full S2 x St action follows from index permutation and an explicit swap sign. Rank and exclusion of disjoint simple cycles are proved for every t>=4. Independent exact integer cycle and finite-field cellular calculations for t=3..8 corroborate without being used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The result gives a complete and natural integral top-homology lattice, exact full graph-symmetry action, and explicit canonical cellular representatives for an infinite nonplanar three-part graph family. It sharply distinguishes a rank-zero boundary case at t=3 from positive non-toric top homology for every t>=4. These concrete non-toric integral classes address a structural gap noted by An–Knudsen while crediting known bare Betti ranks and earlier non-toric examples.
